versions.changelog:
Initial release of guaikei-rednote-scout

- Provides structured data collection for Xiaohongshu (Redbook), supporting hot topic discovery, competitor monitoring, KOL selection, and comment analysis.
- Offers four key commands: keyword search, note details (with comments), influencer post monitoring, and comment extraction.
- Supports flexible filters (content type, sort, date, quantity) and up to 10,000 records per command.
- No user login required; API token authentication only.
- Includes usage examples, detailed input guidance, error handling, and best practices for safe, effective data extraction.
